description:
After 50 billion comments requesting me to do this, I have finally laid my hands on the RX 9060 XT… 16GB.. what were you thinking about there bro?? HUH?? Anyways with this graphics card’s msrp coming out at 350 USD, is it all just glory or is there some sort of a catch that none of us are aware of? That’s what we will try to figure out in todays video

Our Insta : https://www.instagram.com/cbastardyt

Games tested: #cyberpunk2077 #cs2 #forzahorizon5 #valorant #wukong #fortnite #stalker2 #indianajonesandthegreatcircle #marvelrivals #marvel  #blackmythwukong #doomthedarkages

0:00 Talking random stuff
0:50 DOOM THE DARK AGES
1:17 Indiana Jones 
1:33 S.T.A.L.K.E.R 2
1:58 Black Myth: Wukong 
2:20 Counter-Strike 2 
3:05 Call of Duty: Warzone 
3:25 Boring ahh section (Rainbow Six Siege X, Apex legends)
3:30 I forgor to voice over Marvel Rivals 💀
3:51 Cyberpunk 2077

4:40 comparing sizes
5:13 conclusion I guess?
5:28 hiding in the basement

#pc #gaming #pcgaming  #benchmark #gpu #benchmarktest

AMD Ryzen 5 7600
Tower Cooler
Adata XPG Lancer RGB 32GB DDR5 6000MHz

Powercolor Reaper Radeon RX 9060 XT 16GB
